Lyle was arrested when Arthur was 11, and despite their difficult relationship, Arthur kept his father's hat and a photograph. Lyle was known to physically abuse Arthur, who referred to his father as a 'no good bastard' in his journal after witnessing his death. He, alongside Isabelle , is the mascot of the series. Tom is termed a raccoon in the Western versions of the game but a tanuki in the Japanese releases which is a tie to him being a businessman. In Japanese folklore, tanukis bring prosperity and wealth. They are often placed outside businesses such as restaurants and bars for good fortune . In all games leading to New Leaf , he is the manager of the town shop . After the final expansion, Nookington's , he will employ his "nephews" Timmy and Tommy , who work on the second floor in every Animal Crossing series game except New Leaf and New Horizons . itens.trecho: Dr. Neo Periwinkle Cortex [ 1 ] is the main antagonist of the Crash Bandicoot series . He is a mad scientist who holds a grudge against humanity and attempts to take over the world by creating an army of hyper-intelligent animal soldiers. However, one of said animal soldiers, a bandicoot named Crash , turned out to be a failed specimen, and now constantly foils Cortex's plans. ↑ Cortex's middle name was revealed to be Periwinkle by Ebenezer Von Clutch in Crash Tag Team Racing .

itens.trecho: Pit is the main protagonist of the Kid Icarus franchise. He first appeared in Kid Icarus for the Nintendo Entertainment System in 1986, followed by an appearance in Kid Icarus: Of Myths and Monsters for the Game Boy in 1991. Other than a handful of cameos, Pit didn't make another major appearance until the release of Super Smash Bros. Brawl in 2008, and again in the 2012 Nintendo 3DS title Kid Icarus: Uprising . Pit is Palutena 's most loyal servant, as well as the captain of her royal bodyguards. Before the events of the first game, Medusa turns all of Palutena's angels into stone, only sparing Pit because he couldn't fly. He is sometimes erroneously referred to as "Kid Icarus" due to confusing his name with the English title of the series, similarly to how people often mistake Link's name as Zelda because of the title of the series being Legend of Zelda. He is voiced by Antony Del Rio

Ganondorf , also known as the Evil King , King of the Gerudo , or Demon King , is a powerful Gerudo warlock, and, as his name clearly suggests, is none other than Ganon , the main antagonist of The Legend of Zelda series , as a human rather than the ferocious boar-like beast. While he technically debuted in the original The Legend of Zelda as his actual monster form , Ganondorf himself made his first appearance in Ocarina of Time , but was first mentioned in A Link to the Past . He has since been present or referred to in some games, though he was absent from the mainline titles after Twilight Princess until Tears of the Kingdom . itens.trecho: Not to be confused with Dixie Kong's younger sister, Tiny Kong . Dixie Kong is a female Kong from the Donkey Kong series. She is Diddy Kong 's girlfriend and Tiny Kong ’s older sister. [ 4 ] She also has two cousins, the 3 year old toddler Kiddy Kong and his older brother Chunky Kong . [ 5 ] Her first appearance was as Diddy's partner in the game Donkey Kong Country 2 . Aside from games, Dixie also appeared in the Donkey Kong Country animated series and in two comics as well. Dixie Kong appears in almost all Donkey Kong games and in some Mario spin-off titles. She is playable in almost all of the games she appears on.
